disciplinary_grounds.quote: commits an act prohibited under Section 164.052;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of, or placed on deferred adjudication for, a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is convicted of, or is placed on deferred adjudication community supervision or deferred disposition for: (A) a felony; or (B) a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commits or attempts to commit a direct or indirect violation of a rule adopted under this subtitle.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commits or attempts to commit a direct or indirect violation of a rule adopted under this subtitle, either as a principal, accessory, or accomplice;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, drunkenness, drug use, or mental or physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of: (A) illness; (B) drunkenness; (C) excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or another substance; or (D) a mental or physical condition;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found by a court judgment to be of unsound mind.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is found by a court judgment to be of unsound mind;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fails to practice medicine in an acceptable professional manner consistent with public health and welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to practice medicine in an acceptable professional manner consistent with public health and welfare;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Removed, suspended, or disciplined by peers in a professional medical association or by a hospital, if action was based on unprofessional conduct or incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is removed, suspended, or is subject to disciplinary action taken by the person's peers in a local, regional, state, or national professional medical association or society, or is disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of a hospital

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject to repeated or recurring meritorious health care liability claims evidencing professional incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is subject to repeated or recurring meritorious health care liability claims that in the board's opinion evidence professional incompetence likely to injure the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holds a license subject to disciplinary action in another state for acts prohibited under Texas law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: holds a license to practice medicine subject to disciplinary action by another state, or subject to disciplinary action by the uniformed services of the United States, based on acts by the person that are prohibited under Section 164.052 or are similar to acts described by this subsection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submits a false or misleading statement, document, or certificate in an application for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commits unprofessional or dishonorable conduct likely to deceive or defraud the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commits unprofessional or dishonorable conduct that is likely to deceive or defraud the public, as provided by Section 164.053, or injure the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Uses an advertising statement that is false, misleading, or deceptive.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: uses an advertising statement that is false, misleading, or deceptive;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonates a physician or permits another to use the person's license to practice medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: impersonates a physician or permits another to use the person's license or certificate to practice medicine in this state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly aids or abets the practice of medicine by an unlicensed person or entity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: directly or indirectly aids or abets the practice of medicine by a person, partnership, association, or corporation that is not licensed to practice medicine by the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fails to keep complete and accurate records of purchases and disposals of controlled substances or dangerous drugs.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to keep complete and accurate records of purchases and disposals of: (A) drugs listed in Chapter 481, Health and Safety Code; or (B) controlled substances scheduled in the Comprehensive Drug Abuse Prevention and Control Act of 1970

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writes prescriptions for or dispenses to a person known or reasonably known to be a narcotic or controlled substance abuser.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: writes prescriptions for or dispenses to a person who: (A) is known to be an abuser of narcotic drugs, controlled substances, or dangerous drugs; or (B) the physician should have known was an abuser

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writes false or fictitious prescriptions for dangerous or controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: writes false or fictitious prescriptions for: (A) dangerous drugs as defined by Chapter 483, Health and Safety Code; or (B) controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribes or administers a drug or treatment that is nontherapeutic in nature or manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribes or administers a drug or treatment that is nontherapeutic in nature or nontherapeutic in the manner the drug or treatment is administered or prescribed;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fails to adequately supervise the activities of those acting under the physician's supervision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to supervise adequately the activities of those acting under the supervision of the physician;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegates professional medical responsibility to a person the physician knows or has reason to know is not qualified.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: delegates professional medical responsibility or acts to a person if the delegating physician knows or has reason to know that the person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform the responsibility or acts.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A pain management clinic may not operate in this state unless the clinic is certified under this chapter.

definition_quote.value: 'Practicing medicine' means the diagnosis, treatment, or offer to treat a mental or physical disease or disorder or a physical deformity or injury by any system or method, or the attempt to effect cures of those conditions, by a person who: (A) publicly professes to be a physician or surgeon; or (B) directly or indirectly charges money or other compensation for those services.
definition_quote.quote: 'Practicing medicine' means the diagnosis, treatment, or offer to treat a mental or physical disease or disorder or a physical deformity or injury by any system or method, or the attempt to effect cures of those conditions, by a person who: (A) publicly professes to be a physician or surgeon; or (B) directly or indirectly charges money or other compensation for those services.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, treatment, or offer to treat a mental or physical disease or disorder or a physical deformity or injury by any system or method, or the attempt to effect cures of those conditions

drug_authority.value: A physician licensed under this subtitle may supply a patient with any drug, remedy, or clinical supply necessary to meet the patient's immediate needs. May prescribe Schedule III, IV, V controlled substances and, in limited circumstances, Schedule II controlled substances via delegation. May prescribe low-THC cannabis if board-certified in relevant specialty.
drug_authority.quote: A physician licensed under this subtitle may supply a patient with any drug, remedy, or clinical supply necessary to meet the patient's immediate needs.

license_status_types.quote: The board may adopt rules and set reasonable fees relating to placing license holders on inactive status.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must: hold a valid ECFMG certificate; complete at least 2 years of board-approved graduate medical training in the US or Canada; graduate from a school meeting curriculum requirements; and be able to communicate in English.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: holds a valid certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: successfully completed one year of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada

pain_management_education_required.quote: A physician licensed under this subtitle who submits an application for renewal of a license that designates a direct patient care practice must complete, in accordance with this section, not less than two hours of continuing medical education regarding safe and effective pain management related to the prescription of opioids and other controlled substances

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Delegation of Schedule II controlled substance prescribing is limited to hospital facility-based practice settings for admitted patients or emergency department patients, or for patients receiving hospice care. Physicians may only delegate Schedule III-V controlled substance prescriptions for up to 90-day periods. The board must adopt guidelines for opioid antagonist prescription.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A physician may delegate the prescribing or ordering of a controlled substance listed in Schedule II as established by the commissioner of the Department of State Health Services under Chapter 481, Health and Safety Code, only: (1) in a hospital facility-based practice under Section 157.054

pain_management_clinic_registration_requ.quote: A pain management clinic may not operate in this state unless the clinic is certified under this chapter.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A valid practitioner-patient relationship exists for telemedicine if the physician has a preexisting relationship, communicates under a call coverage agreement, or provides services via synchronous audiovisual interaction, asynchronous store-and-forward technology, or other audiovisual telecommunication. Prescribing abortifacients via telemedicine is prohibited.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: a practitioner-patient relationship is not present if a practitioner prescribes an abortifacient or any other drug or device that terminates a pregnancy.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A person who is physically located in another jurisdiction but who, through the use of any medium, including an electronic medium, performs an act that is part of a patient care service initiated in this state... is considered to be engaged in the practice of medicine in this state and is subject to appropriate regulation by the board.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The member states hereby create the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Commission.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician may delegate to an advanced practice registered nurse or physician assistant, acting under adequate physician supervision, the act of prescribing or ordering a drug or device as authorized through a prescriptive authority agreement between the physician and the advanced practice registered nurse or physician assistant

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe nonprescription drugs, dangerous drugs, and Schedule III-V controlled substances (up to 90-day supply); Schedule II controlled substances only in hospital facility-based settings for admitted or ED patients or hospice patients, under a prescriptive authority agreement.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician's authority to delegate the prescribing or ordering of a drug or device under this subchapter is limited to: (1) nonprescription drugs; (2) dangerous drugs; and (3) controlled substances to the extent provided by Subsections (b) and (b-1).

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: the combined number of advanced practice registered nurses and physician assistants with whom a physician may enter into a prescriptive authority agreement may not exceed seven advanced practice registered nurses and physician assistants or the full-time equivalent of seven advanced practice registered nurses and physician assistants.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Each insurer shall submit to the board the report or other information described by Section 160.053 at the time prescribed.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: A medical peer review committee or health care entity shall report in writing to the board the results and circumstances of a medical peer review that: (1) adversely affects the clinical privileges of a physician for a period longer than 14 days;

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The Texas Physician Health Program is established to promote: (1) physician and physician assistant wellness; and (2) treatment of all health conditions that have the potential to compromise the physician's or physician assistant's ability to practice with reasonable skill and safety, including mental health issues, substance abuse issues, and addiction issues.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In enforcing Section 164.051(a)(4), the board, on probable cause, shall request the affected physician or applicant to submit to a mental or physical examination by physicians designated by the board.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board shall adopt rules for the issuance of a license that limits the license holder to the practice of administrative medicine.
